lemmas.name: find_key
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List (Int × Int)), (l.map Prod.fst).Nodup → ∀ (p : Int × Int), p ∈ l → l.find? (fun q => q.1 == p.1) = some p
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro l hnd p hp
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons q t ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hnd
    by_cases hq : q.1 = p.1
    · have hqp : q = p := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with h | h
        · exact h.symm
        · exfalso; exact hnd.1 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, h, hq.symm⟩)
      simp [List.find?_cons, hq, hqp]
    · have : p ∈ t := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with h | h
        · exact absurd (by rw [h]) hq
        · exact h
      simp [List.find?_cons, hq, ih hnd.2 this]

lemmas.name: upd104
lemmas.statement: ∀ (m1 m2 : Map Int Int) (h : update_map_precond m1 m2), update_map_postcond m1 m2 (Map.mk (((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1)))) h
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro m1 m2 h
  obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := h
  have hperm := List.mergeSort_perm ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries)
    (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1))
  generalize hS : ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).mergeSort
      (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1)) = S at hperm
  have hkeys : ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).map Prod.fst |>.Nodup := by
    rw [List.map_append, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨?_, hn2, ?_⟩
    · exact (hn1.sublist (List.Sublist.map _ (List.filter_sublist)))
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      subst hab
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
      have := (List.mem_filter.mp hp).2
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
      have : (m2.entries.any (fun q' => q'.1 == p.1)) = true :=
        List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨q, hq, by simp [hqe]⟩
      simp_all
  have hSkeys : (S.map Prod.fst).Nodup := (hperm.map Prod.fst).nodup_iff.mpr hkeys
  have hsorted : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1) = true) S := by
    rw [← hS]
    exact List.pairwise_mergeSort (by intro a b c h1 h2; simp at *; omega) (by intro a b; simp; omega) _
  have hfind : ∀ x, x ∈ S → find? (⟨S⟩ : Map Int Int) x.1 = some x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    show (S.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1)).map (·.2) = some x.2
    rw [find_key S hSkeys x hx]; rfl
  unfold update_map_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hsorted.imp (fun h => by simpa using h)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    have hxS : x ∈ S := hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hx))
    exact decide_eq_true (hfind x hxS)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    show (match (m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1)).map (·.2) with
      | some _ => true
      | none => decide (find? (⟨S⟩ : Map Int Int) x.1 = some x.2)) = true
    cases hf : m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1) with
    | some y => simp
    | none =>
      have hnone : (m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == x.1)) = false :=
        List.any_eq_false.mpr (fun q hq => by simpa using List.find?_eq_none.mp hf q hq)
      have hxS : x ∈ S := hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, by simp [hnone]⟩)))
      simpa using decide_eq_true (hfind x hxS)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro y hy
    have hyU := hperm.mem_iff.mp hy
    show (match (m1.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1)).map (·.2) with
      | some v => (match (m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1)).map (·.2) with
        | some v' => decide (y.2 = v')
        | none => decide (y.2 = v))
      | none => decide ((m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1)).map (·.2) = some y.2)) = true
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hyU with hf | hm2
    · obtain ⟨hy1, hnoany⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hf
      have h1 : m1.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = some y := find_key m1.entries hn1 y hy1
      have hany : (m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == y.1)) = false := by simpa using hnoany
      have h2 : m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = none :=
        List.find?_eq_none.mpr (fun q hq hqy => by
          have := List.any_eq_false.mp hany q hq
          exact this hqy)
      rw [h1, h2]; simp
    · have h2 : m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = some y := find_key m2.entries hn2 y hm2
      rw [h2]
      cases h1 : m1.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) <;> simp
